name: Souheila Yacoub
bio:
Souheila Yacoub (born 29 June 1992) is a Swiss actress, theatremaker, former rhythmic gymnast, and Miss Suisse Romande 2012 winner. Her films include Climax (2018), Making Of (2023), and Dune: Part Two (2024). On television, she appeared in the Canal+ miniseries Savages (2019).
